responses.text: Hold up! There are Deathclaws all over the damn place north of here. I'd turn back if I were you.
If you want to get to New Vegas, you're better off heading east from Primm and then looping north. It's a heck of a lot safer.
Can't believe anyone actually made it through from the north, what with all the Deathclaws at the quarry. You returning from New Vegas?
You need something?

topics.prompt: GREETING

responses.text: If you insist on going north, don't be expecting a rescue when you get into trouble.
Yep.

topics.prompt: Goodbye.

responses.text: I've been there once, and I don't recommend it. It's just a way to burn through a month's pay in five minutes.
I've seen a lot of folks come through here thinking they'll have the easy life once they get there. It never happens.

topics.prompt: What can you tell me about New Vegas?

responses.text: They moved into the quarry after the Powder Gangers came through and made off with most of our dynamite.
We shut the quarry down while we waited for the NCR to get us some more blasting sticks, but now the Deathclaws have shown up.
The NCR's a no-show, and my men and I have got nothing to do but sit on our asses all day. It's damn frustrating.

topics.prompt: Where'd the Deathclaws come from?

responses.text: They're a bunch of escaped cons from down south. The NCR was using them to maintain the railways as part of their sentence.
I don't know who screwed up, but the Powder Gangers are loose. It was one group that attacked us and took our entire supply of dynamite.

topics.prompt: Tell me about the Powder Gangers.

responses.text: We'd see them occasionally, but they didn't seem too keen on getting too close to the quarry. Not sure if it was the noise or all the workers.
I can't believe that an entire pack moved into the quarry. I thought that kind of bad luck only happened in New Vegas.

topics.prompt: Have you had problems with Deathclaws before?

responses.text: Have you even seen a Deathclaw? They're taller than a man and far, far stronger and faster. And, there's a whole pack of them out there.
You'd have to be the meanest, toughest, roughest bastard in the wasteland to have any chance against them, and I don't think that's you.
You'd need to take out the pack leaders - the Mother Deathclaw and the Deathclaw Alpha Male. Kill 'em, and the pack will scatter. Pretty tough job.
I don't what it is about you, but I think you could actually pull it off. Deathclaws are tough bastards, but you might be even tougher.
Nobody here's any use to you in a fight against Deathclaws, but take these medical supplies. You'll probably need them.
To do the job right, you've got to get rid of the pack leaders - the Mother Deathclaw and the Deathclaw Alpha Male. Should run the rest of 'em off.

topics.prompt: I could take care of your Deathclaw problem.

responses.text: Okay.

topics.prompt: Let's talk about something else.

responses.text: This is Sloan, a camp for us quarry workers. The actual quarry, Quarry Junction, is up the road north of here. The whole thing is an NCR operation.
We make cement for the NCR using the limestone we dig out with dynamite and draglines. Dirty work, but the pay's good.
Wish we got paid in caps, though. Not a lot of merchants like taking NCR paper money.

topics.prompt: What is this place?

responses.text: It all gets shipped by rail over towards Boulder City and Hoover Dam. The NCR's probably building fortifications with it all.

topics.prompt: What does the NCR need with the cement?

responses.text: It's a big machine which moves rocks around, piles at a time. It's Pre-War tech, so you need to thump it once in awhile to keep it running.

topics.prompt: What's a dragline?

responses.text: Nope. The NCR's been trying to switch over to using paper money, like in the Pre-War days. Trouble is that the exchange rates ain't exactly fair.
For example, a hundred bucks in NCR money is valued at roughly half that in caps around here. Seems like a rotten deal for us, but work is work.

topics.prompt: You don't get paid in caps?

responses.text: Ah, yes. I think I know which friend you mean. Even if there weren't Deathclaws in the quarry, there'd still be no delivery.
The supplier, a guy in Primm named Tyrone, is a cheating son of a bitch who won't deliver even though he's already been paid in advance.

topics.prompt: I'm looking for a suitcase filled with chemical supplies for a... friend. Know anything?

responses.text: Sure.

topics.prompt: Let's talk about something else.

responses.text: Yeah, he - or she, I guess - wandered into camp a couple of months back. Seemed friendly enough.
Ugly-looking thing, but the guys like having it around. Good for morale and all that.

topics.prompt: I noticed you have a tame molerat.

responses.text: It's nice to see things going the way they're supposed to, for a change. I'm going to pay you out of my own pocket for this one.

topics.prompt: I repaired your generator.

responses.text: I'd noticed Snuffles limping, but I didn't realize the problem was that serious. Thanks - that beast helps keep spirits up around here.

topics.prompt: I fixed Snuffles' leg.

responses.text: You... you did? That's pretty amazing - I figured you'd need artillery to take her out.
I hate to say it, but as long as the Alpha Male is still alive, that pack isn't going anywhere, even with the Deathclaw Mother out of the picture.

topics.prompt: I killed the Mother Deathclaw.

responses.text: You... you did? That's pretty amazing - I figured you'd need artillery to take him out.
I hate to say it, but as long as the Deathclaw Mother is still alive, that pack isn't going anywhere. She'll take another mate and keep laying eggs.

topics.prompt: I killed the Deathclaw Alpha Male.

responses.text: Coming from anyone else, I'd say they were drunk or crazy, but that look in your eyes - I believe you.
I can pay you, but it ain't much for what you pulled off. I'll get on the ham radio first thing and tell people all about you, though.

topics.prompt: I killed the Deathclaw Mother and the Deathclaw Alpha Male.

responses.text: I'm just the middle man. The Great Khans are a hard group, and some of them are no good, but they're not all the same.
I believe in the NCR, but that doesn't make it right for them to roll over anyone who doesn't want any part of 'em.

topics.prompt: You don't care that you're helping the Great Khans?

responses.text: He's always been shady, but this is the first time he's outright screwed me.

topics.prompt: Has Tyrone cheated you before?

responses.text: Good luck.

topics.prompt: All right. I'll go pay a visit to Tyrone.

responses.text: She's my daughter. Takes a little too much after her mother, rest her soul, but she's happy with the Great Khans, and that's enough for me.

topics.prompt: How do you know Melissa?
